versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Video Inpainting skill for RunComfy via CLI.
- Supports region-based edits across video frames: object removal, watermark cleanup, region replacement.
- Automatically routes requests to the most suitable model: Wan 2-7 Edit-Video (default), Lucy Edit Restyle, or Seedream 4-0 Edit-Sequential.
- Responds to various trigger phrases for video region editing tasks.
- Provides clear guidance on CLI usage, prompting, and selection of advanced workflows for mask-driven or pixel-precise inpainting.
- Includes troubleshooting tips and exit codes for common CLI responses.
